2026-10-19 23:28:53.982515 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-10-19 23:28:53.982522 | controller |
2026-10-19 23:28:53.982527 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-19 23:28:53.982533 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-19 23:28:53.982538 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-19 23:28:53.982545 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-19 23:28:53.982557 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-19 23:28:53.982563 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
